notes.title: The (likely) final update!
notes.content: God Edge is playable windowed!  Use 'Alt + Enter' to exit fullscreen mode and resize the window as you like!  You can also use 'Alt + Enter' to go back into fullscreen mode.

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility Update!
notes.content: Now you can play God Edge on the Steam Deck!  Save Azmra anywhere, anytime!

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
-Fixed text fade boxes not disappearing.
-Fixed "land" sound effect playing during tutorial cutscene.
-Fixed missing fade from dialog in Davlentown church.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398321/64884563d4fa901d6aace7ce535da3e51137f9e8.png[/img]
The response to God Edge has been great!  Here are some QoL changes asked for by players.


-Added keyboard controls in "Discussion" and add an image for faster reference.

-Added "Hold A on controller / Hold K on keyboard during cutscenes to skip them".

-Added colorless versions of the achievement images to locked achievements to be used as clues to obtain instead of image that just says "LOCKED".

-Changed "Potion Spell" text in Book of Knowledge to "Heal Spell" in all three instances.
